title: NNSA recurring qualified rate receives an immutable public change-notice contract
summary: Every publication, withdrawal, rollback, supersession, restoration, or republication notice binds its controlling event, receipt, event digest, and exact bundle digest; corrections append and never rewrite. Denominator: One contract-specific notice schema, fourteen integrity cases, six valid notice types, eight explicit rejections, and zero actual public change notices issued.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Immutable public change-notice controls.
